For more information, search for ‘Harry Junie’ in the search bar~👉

If you are looking for a unique exhibition or indoor date course at Gangnam Station, I would like to recommend the free exhibition between the everyday and the non-daily.

For about a month and a half from November 14 to December 31, 2025, the special exhibition ‘Borders of Creation: AI, Humans, and Art’, prepared in collaboration with Gallery Horton, is being held for free.

This is a rare opportunity to see the works of a total of 9 artists, from famous to new artists, for free, so I think it will be perfect for those looking for something to do at Gangnam Station.

This exhibition is a contemporary art-centered exhibition that explores the intersection of art, technology, and human imagination.

The participating artists include the following 9 artists, and even though it is a free exhibition, the lineup is truly spectacular.

The exhibition spans three floors (basement level, first floor, and second floor), and each floor had a different atmosphere, so it was nice to naturally follow the route.

reviews.text:
To go from Beomgye Station to Samseong Station, I'm going to take metropolitan bus number 3030 to Yangjae Station. However, because of the bus transfer, the distance to the next stop is quite far.

So I decided to go to Gangnam Station and take the subway. I got off the bus, walked across the crosswalk to Gangnam Station, and people were crowded in front of the Pika Pika Lego Shop.

I don't like Lego very much, but during my trip to Japan, I visited Legoland in Nagoya twice, rode the Lego train, ate a Lego burger, and took a Lego manhole.

After going to Samseong Station and then going to Samseong Station for afternoon tea, we saw Lego and quickly changed the route to Samseong Station after afternoon tea.

The LEGO 90th Anniversary Pop-up Store is located on Gangnam-daero next to the old City Theater, so it is easily visible. The period is until August 14th.

1F is a participation space, and you must download the Daily Non-Daily Life Gap app and register as a member to participate. If you do not use the app, you cannot participate in the event, but you can view it.

I also participated and completed the mission of stacking Lego blocks and making my own Lego, received a stamp, received a doll claw coin, and succeeded in the capsule raffle challenge.

The product I chose is the Lego Golden Keyring. This is a genuine product sold in stores for about 15,000 won! lucky ♥️
The 2nd floor, connected to the 1st floor store, is a Lego shop.

Here, U+ members can purchase at a discount. The works of LEGO artists are on display on the first floor of the basement.

Although the place is not large, it is full of Lego from B1F to 2F. There is also a space where children can build their own LEGOs. Please pick up a gift as well^^ Thank you.

reviews.text:
I made a quick reservation, but I had no idea it would be such an unforgettable day.
It was my first time going to GS Arts Center, and I was satisfied because I was in the 4th row of Block B on the first floor, so I could see the stage and the actors' expressions well.
There was no step between the 1st and 3rd rows, so the 4th row was better.
The map says to go out through exit 8, but exit 7 is directly connected to the building, so you can go straight through exit 7.
There was a yellow Rolls-Royce photo zone in the lobby, which was great for taking pictures, and there was also a cocktail tower 4-cut booth.
However, it was a little disappointing that the casting board was only on the upper floor.
As soon as I entered the stage, I was immersed in the sound of waves and the ocean.
There were subtitles in front and on both sides of the stage, so even in the front row it wasn't too much of an inconvenience.
I was impressed by the way the actor who played Jordan danced and sang with ease, and my friend who watched the original also said that the adaptation was interesting.
What was disappointing was that the actor's lines were not clear and the sounds of preparations behind the stage could be heard.
Still, it was 5 out of 5 stars thanks to the energy of the actors and the gorgeous stage.
After the performance, I met the actor who played Gatsby in the lobby and took a picture with him.
It was possible to take pictures of the curtain call, making memories, and it was a performance worth the price of the ticket.
Recommended as a must-see musical this season!!!!
